decision_log.reason: Owner confirms technical improvements but rejects transport-only value; preserve working history.
Strong alternatives already provide requirement mapping, test generation, evidence and reports.

decision_log.decision: Do not treat Git metadata/hash/report as moat
decision_log.reason: These are established capabilities; candidate must prove lower human acceptance burden beyond configuration.

decision_log.decision: Separate historic archive validity from current-directory drift
decision_log.reason: Eight uploaded images still match historical inventories; do not rewrite historical proof or retrofit missing version tags.

decision_log.decision: Select small responsibility-based segment, not all beginners
decision_log.reason: Experience labels alone do not establish recurring business need, access or willingness to pay.

decision_log.decision: Prepare offline P0 before model-connected MVP
decision_log.reason: Need stable inputs and evidence states for any meaningful AI evaluation; not a market PASS or automatic code authorization.

decision_log.decision: Keep integrity, criterion judgment and owner decision independent
decision_log.reason: A file existing, a model suggestion and a business acceptance are different claims.

decision_log.decision: Write bounded research docs to meta/master-state only
decision_log.reason: Latest user explicitly permits GitHub research recording. No product branch/code push or external sharing implied.

hypotheses.claim: Criterion-linked evidence will reduce correct-decision handling time versus strongest existing baseline
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement including setup/uploads/reading, or extra false acceptance/return-work.

hypotheses.claim: Non-engineering owners with recurrent low-risk Web delivery responsibility are reachable and value this
hypotheses.falsifier: No repeat real tasks, current alternatives satisfactory, or only enthusiastic hypothetical interest.

hypotheses.claim: A small module is sufficient and easier to adopt than a separate app
hypotheses.falsifier: Module setup itself exceeds savings or requires unavailable execution access.
